name: Victor Švankmajer Krauss
original_name: ヴィクトル・シュヴァンクマイエル・クラウス
source:
Legendary vampire hunter, Ariya's master.

Gentle for humans, ruthless for vampires. He comes to Foggybottom in order to settle the score with one vampire he failed to kill - Toshirou.
